OMV as employer

At OMV, we drive energy, mobility, and lifestyles forward every day. We're working towards becoming an integrated chemicals, fuels and energy company by 2030, and climate neutral by 2050.

Put simply? That means reinventing everyday essentials.

And that takes the best and brightest minds.

This is a place where you can be ambitious.

Feel included and drive innovation. A place that celebrates big thinking, and creates exciting opportunities to learn and grow.

We're calling on people who turn ideas into action.

To become part of a place that celebrates purpose. To contribute to global change by being here.

The best thing about tomorrow is that you can create it. 1 6-Month Internship in Chemical Engineering "By applying to this pool position, you can explore multiple internship opportunities within the business area. We assess your background and connect you with the department that best matches your profile."

What you will learn

 * Familiarization with refinery/petchem processes and their process engineering settings and modes of operation as well as the process control systems.

 * Collaboration in the preparation of process evaluations and reporting.

 * Observation and analysis of new technology and process developments as well as preparation and presentation of summaries.

 * Screening the status of competitive technologies in case of OMV internal developments.

 * Collaboration, preparation, and documentation of regular meetings as well as process database maintenance.

 * Activities and tests in the laboratory and pilot plant on special plants and processes, analysis activities and analysis evaluations.

What we are looking for

 * Currently studying Chemical Engineering and you want to gain practical experience. 

 * Highly creative & innovative.

 * Analytical mindset and talent for working with data and numbers.

 * Microsoft Office is a walk in the park for you.

 * Team-oriented and proactive mindset.

 * Proficient in German and good English language skills. 

Unlock your potential. Make it count.

Together, we'll reinvent everyday essentials. Join us on our journey of transformation, where you can contribute to a long-lasting legacy.

We offer a dynamic and inclusive environment where your potential can thrive. Join us and become part of a team that's shaping a more sustainable future.

The support contribution will be between € 1.100,- and € 1.400,- monthly, depending on your level of education.

Furthermore you will benefit from our canteen with healthy meal options at great prices and exclusive networking events.

At OMV, you matter. Ready to grow?

At OMV, we're passionate about creating an inclusive environment where everyone has the chance to grow and thrive. We embrace diversity in all its forms - whether it's age, gender identity, disability, ethnicity, religion, or sexual orientation - because we know it makes us stronger.

Our success comes from working together as a diverse team and maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Guided by our values - We Care, We're Curious, We Progress - we're shaping a more sustainable future together.

We're especially proud of our efforts to advance women within our organization. In alignment with our strategy 2030 we are focusing on getting 30% women in management and senior leadership positions.

Therefore you will experience excellent learning opportunities that will subsequently help you to unleash your potential.

Together, Forward for good.

1 Industrial Digitalization Engineer (m/f/*) 
What are my responsibilities?

As part of our Industrial Digitalization team within Electrics & Automation, you will develop innovative sensor and automation solutions that make metallurgical processes more transparent, efficient, and data-driven. You will be the technical owner of sensor and automation solutions, guiding them from concept and development through commissioning, customer support, and continuous improvement.

If you are passionate about software development and sensor technologies and have a talent for solving complex problems, join our team and take on the following responsibilities:

 

Engineering & Product Ownership

 * Develop innovative sensor and automation solutions for metallurgical processes.
 * Take responsibility for the complete product lifecycle, from hardware selection and software development through commissioning and customer support at customer sites worldwide
 * Design and implement software components using object-oriented programming principles and C++.
 * Support the acquisition, processing, and utilization of sensor data for industrial applications.
 * Work closely with experts from engineering, data analytics, and process technology to create integrated digital solutions.
 * Contribute to the development of new products and technologies within our Industrial Digitalization portfolio.

 

Technical Expert Activities

 * Create technical documentation, operating manuals, and training materials, and deliver customer training to support successful solution adoption.
 * Act as a technical expert throughout the sales process by supporting customer engagements and contributing to solution concepts, technical specifications, and proposal development.
 * Share technical expertise and content for presentations, demonstrations, and other marketing activities.

What do I need to qualify for this job?

 * Completed technical education (FH, University, or equivalent) in Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Science, or a related field.
 * Solid knowledge of object-oriented programming concepts and practical experience with C++.
 * Practical experience with prototyping, automation, data processing, or related technical applications.
 * Strong interest in combining software development with industrial applications and sensor technologies.
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 * Ability and willingness to explain complex technical concepts to customers, operators, and internal stakeholders through documentation, training, and technical discussions.
 * Fluent German and English communication skills, both written and spoken.

 

Nice to have

 * Experience with sensor technologies  with 2D and/or 3D image processing  in industrial automation environments.
 * Knowledge of signal processing.
 * Pracical experience in working directly with customers in technical project, commissioning, or support environments.

 

You are interested in having considerable freedom of design, work solution- and results-oriented and you love working in a team? Then we look forward to receiving your application!
